scoring_justification: The invariants are integer topological charges and the conductance is derived analytically; comparing the agent's reported values to the paper's exact results with generous tolerances is the strongest feasible verification, as recomputing the 3D integral in the checker would be heavy and may differ in discretisation.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold invariant values and spin Hall conductance for comparison.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported results: N=1 for spinless μ>0, N=0 for μ<0; N=2 for spinful μ>0; N_K=2 for planar μ>0, N_K=0 for μ<0; conductance = 1/(2π) ≈ 0.15915494309189535.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values taken from the paper's main claims (Sections 2.1, 2.2, Eq. (7)). Conductance computed analytically as N_K/(4π) with N_K=2.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The gold numbers are exactly the paper's reported invariants; the solve.sh writes the same values, ensuring consistency between hidden checker and reference oracle.

schema.description: Topological invariants for spinless and spinful chiral phases

outputs.description: Integer topological invariants N for μ>0 and μ<0 in the spinless and spinful chiral p-wave superfluid models.

schema.description: Planar phase invariants and derived spin Hall conductance

outputs.description: Symmetry-protected invariant N_K for μ>0 and μ<0, and the spin Hall conductance σ_{xy}^{spin}=N_K/(4π) evaluated at μ>0.
